generate_image_variations: run the UnCLIPImageVariationPipeline to generate image variations from an input PIL image
prepare_latents: create random noise latents with a given shape dtype and device for the decoder or super resolution scheduler
encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings and hidden states with optional classifier free guidance
encode_image: encode an input image into CLIP image embeddings using the vision model and feature extractor
initialize_pipeline: build an UnCLIPImageVariationPipeline by registering the decoder text encoder image encoder and super resolution UNets
